context: The personalize skill on a DA sandbox. Seven prompts in task.md run as separate sessions against the same setup (run 7 adds component-models.json); each item names the runs it applies to, is judged pass/fail per applicable session, and is weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: preflight_before_change
checklist.description: All runs: detect-project.mjs runs before any file is created or modified, and its project type decides whether the session continues (da) or stops (run 7: exit 3, nothing written).

checklist.name: hook_shown_and_approved
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: the scripts.js patch printed by install-runtime.mjs is shown and confirmed before --apply-hook (or before a hand placement); scripts/aem.js and existing block code are untouched.

checklist.name: default_preserved
checklist.description: Runs 1, 5, 6: the personalized region's original markup moves into content/fragments/personalization/<id>/default.html (or stays inline in the default row); nothing authored is deleted, and every placeholder has a default row.

checklist.name: stardust_content_tree
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: pages and fragments are content/<path>.html body-fragment documents (the deploy shape), not .plain.html files and not a bare page outside content/.

checklist.name: no_invented_copy
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: variant fragments carry TODO: copy unless the user supplied text, and the summary lists the TODOs.

checklist.name: gates_green
checklist.description: Runs 1-6: validate-placeholders, simulate, the project lint and verify-preview all report PASS on the final state (run 3 with the mock; failure runs with --ignore-console), and the summary gives per-variant ?pzn= preview URLs.

checklist.name: consent_respected
checklist.description: Runs 2, 3, 4: the agent explains that visitor tracking, persisted state and engine calls need consent; hasConsent is wired to the CMP or the user is asked; with consent denied no pzn-seen / pzn-vs cookie is set.

checklist.name: api_adapters_and_fallback
checklist.description: Run 3: mapResponse turns the sample into { decisions: { promo: { fragment: '/fragments/personalization/promo/festive' } }, ttl: 120 } checked offline; no key or secret in any browser file; the mock's --fail 500 and --latency 3000 runs end at the rules or default; api.endpoint is same-origin at handover (no localhost mock URL left).

checklist.name: state_live_swap
checklist.description: Run 4: the quiz calls setState('quiz-persona', <persona>) rather than hardcoding show/hide logic; after setState('quiz-persona','cn') the placeholder's data-pzn-variant is the cn variant without navigation; a placeholder without state rules keeps its variant.

checklist.name: edge_worker_contract
checklist.description: Run 5: src/aem-worker.mjs is byte-identical to the vendored asset; simulate --edge --country IN reports source edge, variant india, x-pzn: edge; --ua Googlebot reports the default; cache-control is 'private, no-cache'; cdn/ is in .hlxignore.

checklist.name: outward_actions_asked_not_taken
checklist.description: All runs: no DA upload, preview or publish, wrangler deploy or wrangler secret put happens; any upload is proposed as the deploy-batch.mjs command restricted with --paths and asked first, and deploy commands are handed off in the summary.

checklist.name: declines_out_of_scope
checklist.description: Run 6: the 50/50 A/B test is declined with a pointer to experimentation and no traffic-split logic is generated, while both personalization placeholders still ship with unique ids.
